plain.li: Careful, there's a loose stone just there.
Round the soft patch, not through it.
One step at a time, eyes on the ground.
[rain] Mud like this is how I got hurt last time.
[winter] Ice under the snow, so slowly does it.

cheerful.li: Not falling today, ground, nice try.

plain.li: Knock once on the roof, and it rings sound.
Roof first, then the face.
That one rang true, so I can dig.
Listen to the rock before you cut it.

cold.li: A hollow note means trouble, and this one isn't hollow.

plain.li: Boots by the fire, socks beside them.
Dry feet tomorrow, that's the rule.
Just turning my boots so the toes dry.
Never again with the wet feet.

warm.li: Put yours here too, there's room.

cheerful.li: Toasty boots in the morning, my favorite thing.

plain.li: Was this water boiled first?
Hands washed, water boiled, then we eat.
I'll wait for the kettle, thanks.
Not a drop that hasn't been on the fire.

blunt.li: Boiled, or I'm not drinking it.

gloomy.li: One cup of bad water was all it took last time.

cold.li: Boiled water is the cheapest medicine there is.

plain.li: This fire came from the first night's, you know.
Same flame as the first night, passed along.
I remember how few of us sat round the first one.
Keep it fed, it's older than it looks.

warm.li: Every one of us has warmed their hands at this fire.

cheerful.li: Still burning, all the way from the first night.

plain.li: I wonder what they're doing at the other colony tonight.
I hope they've got enough firewood over there.
Another thing to tell them, when I see them.
The road looks long from here at night.

warm.li: Sleep well over there, all of you.

gloomy.li: I should have said more, before we parted.

plain.li: Oh, the road goes on and the road goes round.
How did the strangers' song go, the second verse?
Hum the road song, and the work goes quicker.
La la, something about a river, la la.

cheerful.li: Everybody, the chorus, you know this one.

gloomy.li: It's a song about leaving, and they left.

plain.li: Sun's gone, I should be inside.
This is when the flies come out.
Quickly now, before the biting starts.
I don't like being out after dark any more.

cold.li: The flies feed at dusk, so I should be indoors.
